theorem entrySize_sum_take_succ (cs : List EntryC) (i : Nat) (c : EntryC) (h : cs[i]? = some c) :
    (List.map entrySize (List.take (i + 1) cs)).sum = (List.map entrySize (List.take i cs)).sum +
    entrySize c

theorem w64_add_exact (acc ni : w64) (a e : Nat) (Ha : uint.nat acc = a) (Hni : sint.Z ni = ↑e) (he
    : e < 2 ^ 63) (h : a + e < 2 ^ 64) : uint.nat (acc + ni) = a + e
